class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def convert(head, root):
    if head is None:
        return None
    
    root = Node(head.data)
    
    queue = []
    queue.append(root)
    
    head = head.next
    
    while head:
        front = queue[0]
        
        front.left = Node(head.data)
        queue.append(front.left)
        head = head.next
        
        if head:
            front.right = Node(head.data)
            queue.append(front.right)
            head = head.next
        
        queue.pop(0)
    
    return root

# Helper function to print level order traversal
def printLevelOrder(root):
    if root is None:
        return
    
    queue = []
    queue.append(root)
    
    while queue:
        node = queue.pop(0)
        print(node.data, end=" ")
        
        if node.left:
            queue.append(node.left)
        
        if node.right:
            queue.append(node.right)

# Example usage:
# Create linked list: 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5
head = Node(1)
head.next = Node(2)
head.next.next = Node(3)
head.next.next.next = Node(4)
head.next.next.next.next = Node(5)

root = None
root = convert(head, root)

# Print level order traversal of the constructed binary tree
printLevelOrder(root)
